jm.common.map_style_nether_surface_light: When enabled, uses actual world light levels for the Nether surface map. When disabled, uses maximum brightness so the map is always visible.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer.tooltip: Controls where in the HUD rendering order the minimap is drawn. Earlier layers render below later ones.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_first.toolti: Renders the minimap before all other HUD elements.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_before_effec: Renders the minimap before status effect icons.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_after_effect: Renders the minimap after status effect icons.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_before_score: Renders the minimap before the scoreboard sidebar, so the scoreboard appears on top.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_after_scoreb: Renders the minimap after the scoreboard sidebar.
jm.minimap.hud_render_layer_last.tooltip: Renders the minimap after all other HUD elements (default).
